# `adt domain`

ABAP domain operations

```bash
adt domain [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command               | Description                         |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `adt domain create`   | Create a new ABAP domain            |
| `adt domain read`     | Read source code of an ABAP domain  |
| `adt domain activate` | Activate one or more ABAP domain(s) |
| `adt domain delete`   | Delete an ABAP domain               |

## `adt domain create`

Create a new ABAP domain

```bash
adt domain create [options] <name> <description> <package>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument        | Description       | Default |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ------- |
| `<name>`        | domain name       |         |
| `<description>` | Short description |         |
| `<package>`     | Package name      |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                   | Default |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number      |         |
| `--no-error-existing`      | Skip if domain already exists | `false` |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON                |         |

## `adt domain read`

Read source code of an ABAP domain

```bash
adt domain read [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description | Default |
| -------- | ----------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | domain name |         |

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                                                                     | Default |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`              | Output metadata as JSON (no source)                                                             |         |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Write source to &lt;file&gt; in UTF-8 instead of stdout (avoids shell redirect encoding issues) |         |

## `adt domain activate`

Activate one or more ABAP domain(s)

```bash
adt domain activate [options] <names...>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description    | Default |
| ------------ | -------------- | ------- |
| `<names...>` | domain name(s) |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

## `adt domain delete`

Delete an ABAP domain

```bash
adt domain delete [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description | Default |
| -------- | ----------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | domain name |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `-y, --yes`                | Skip confirmation prompt |         |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON           |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
